conclusion.phenomenon: Repeated request timeouts for authentication service
conclusion.causal_chain: Two identical timeout failures occurred simultaneously for the same email and token, suggesting a dependency (e.g., auth backend or network path) is unreachable or overloaded.
conclusion.alternatives: Client-side network outage; misconfigured client timeout; DNS resolution failure; upstream service down.
conclusion.contradictions: No evidence of client-side errors (e.g., DNS failures, connection refused); no logs showing retries or fallback behavior.
missing: network latency or packet loss data
recommendations: Check availability and response time of auth backend
Verify DNS resolution for auth endpoint
Inspect network path (firewalls, proxies) between client and auth service
Review client timeout configuration against expected backend latency
conclusion.boundary: 真实模型分析；模拟日志来源。模型判断不是因果证明，建议不会自动执行。
